value.message: Halton Hills Gymnastics Centre has Parent and Tot for 18 months to 3.11 yrs, fall session Sept 12 to Dec 18, plus a $15 Pre-school Drop In Tue/Thu 9:30am-12 - their site says; Town Recreation lists Tiny Dancers at Gellert, Sat 8:30, Sep 26 to Dec 12, $117. I could not get into their pages today, so no price or registration date for Parent and Tot; I'll keep watching and text you when I have them.
